name: Azelis Group NV
summary: Azelis Group NV functions as a global distributor, supplying specialized chemicals and food ingredients. The company's operations extend across a diverse range of life science sectors, including personal care, pharmaceuticals, food and wellness products, specialized agricultural and horticultural solutions, and both homecare and industrial chemicals. Furthermore, Azelis provides materials for the industrial chemicals industry, encompassing applications like CASE (Coatings, Adhesives, Sealants, Elastomers), rubber and plastic additives, lubricants and metalworking fluids, electronics, essential and fine chemicals, textiles, leather, and paper. Established in 1996, Azelis Group NV is headquartered in Antwerp, Belgium, and operates as a subsidiary of Akita I S.À R.L.
